documents.title: Bambu PLA Basic Technical Data Sheet V3.0
Bambu PLA Basic Safety Data Sheet SDS20250724A00
Bambu Lab Filament Hex Code Table: PLA Basic (4 pack)
Filament guide: printer, nozzle, AMS, build plate and glue compatibility

notes: The pack is four 1 kg spools of PLA Basic (Bambu Green, Jade White, Gray, Black; store page "What's in the Bundle"). The store page links the PLA Basic TDS, SDS and a 4-pack hex-code table, so every TDS/SDS value here is the PLA Basic document's value, per spool.

Hex entries are keyed by the colour names exactly as the 4-pack hex-code table writes them. The product has no colour option (its groups are Type "Filament with spool" and Size "1kg*4"), so source_value_id is empty and each entry names its bundle item instead. The four hexes agree with the single-colour PLA Basic hex table (Jade White #FFFFFF, Gray #8E9089, Bambu Green #00AE42, Black #000000).

Mechanical keys hold the TDS X-Y printed-specimen values (the registry has no *.printed / *.material split; raw-material properties are under material.* and thermal.*, printed-specimen results only under mechanical.*). The Z values are in each row's test_condition and are not stored as values.

TDS facts with no registry key are not stored: Young's modulus (X-Y 2580 ± 220 MPa, Z 2060 ± 170 MPa), melt index (23.2 ± 3.5 g/10 min at 210 °C, 2.16 kg), saturated water absorption (0.43 % at 25 °C, 55% RH), spool material and size (ABS, temperature resistance 70 °C; diameter 200 mm, height 67 mm), printing and storage humidity (< 20% RH), retraction length and speed, max overhang angle (55°), max bridging length (30 mm), support material (Support for PLA), and the chemical-resistance rows.

thermal.chamber_temp is not stored although the TDS (p.2) gives "Chamber Temperature 25 - 45 °C": the registry key is a single number used for a printer's chamber capability, and this is a recommended range for printing the filament.

material.diameter_tolerance and material.spool_type are neither stored here nor listed as not_published: the store page states them ("Diameter: 1.75mm +/- 0.03mm"; Type "Filament with spool"), so the page rows stand and "not published by the manufacturer" would be untrue.

safety.certifications is neither stored nor listed as not_published: the store page links RoHS, POPs, CP65, TSCA, SVHC, PAHs and EN71-3 documents, which were not in the offline cache and were not read.

The page's deterministic relation "requires spool" (from the generic FAQ sentence "The refill filament needs to be used with a spool.") does not apply to this pack: its only Type value is "Filament with spool" and every bundle item is "Filament with Spool". No curated relation says otherwise; it is flagged for the integrator.
